info.description:
-

The subject
introduces vocabulary and topics around familiar topics such as 
psychology, communication, gastronomy, finance,
business 
and
 society
 in the form
of dialogues, newsletters and lectures.
;

-

Learners are
acquainted with note-taking and pre-listening prediction skills based on
available contexts, the ability to identify key messages and details during
listening as well as attitudes, intonations, and implications of speakers in familiar
context as well as low-level notes and classifications
;
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Understand the meaning of key words and simple phrases related to familiar topics
Apply different techniques flexibly so as to identify the structure of the listening texts , reason, predict information while listening
Analyze the basic idea of the speeches related to simple, close themes that are presented slowly and clearly.
